concepts.title: Геральдика и пергамент
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE original high-fidelity PC medieval role-playing game INVENTORY AND EQUIPMENT screen, a polished visual design proposal. Landscape 16:9, preferably 2560x1440 or higher. Perfectly flat front-on digital screenshot, edge-to-edge interface, NOT a photograph of a monitor, no physical monitor frame, no presentation board, no multi-image collage.
The user likes the medieval craftsmanship of Kingdom Come Deliverance menus and the austere atmospheric readability of Dark Souls equipment screens. Design an original interface, do not reproduce any game's logos or named characters.
Show meaningful usable controls at realistic readable scale. Use illustrated raster textures, hand-crafted iconography and fine serif typography. All actual interface labels in clear correctly spelled Russian Cyrillic, straight aligned baseline. Restrained ornament outside reading areas, excellent text contrast. No modern dashboard cards, rounded pills, neon glow, sci-fi elements, firearms, giant promotional lettering or watermark.
Comparable demonstration content: a single adult male traveller in a brown wool tunic, worn chainmail shirt, dark trousers, practical leather boots and belt; grounded medieval European equipment, no fantasy spikes. A steel arming sword is selected. Item icons include a sword, round wooden shield, simple helmet, folded cloak, leather gloves, leather boots, leather waterskin, loaf of bread, bandages, a small key, a coin pouch. These are illustrative inventory contents, not a new game's logo.
Top navigation text exactly: "Персонаж" "Инвентарь" "Умения" "Журнал" "Карта". "Инвентарь" is selected.
Short text to place where appropriate, with no long paragraphs: "Снаряжение", "Сумка", "Описание", "Стальной меч", "Одноручное оружие", "Урон 32", "Вес 1,4", "Прочность 86 / 100", "Здоровье 100", "Выносливость 85", "Вес 24 / 40", "Монеты 128".
Bottom discreet keyboard hints: "E Надеть" "R Переложить" "Esc Закрыть".
Keep the interface spacious and actually usable at 1080p, with a convincing full-body character preview and enough inventory space. The character is subordinate to the interface, not a poster hero. Fill the entire canvas with this one menu screen.
DIRECTION A — WARM HERALDIC INVENTORY, inspired by historical manuscript craftsmanship and Kingdom Come's warmth.
A richly crafted but disciplined equipment interface: aged ivory parchment, oxblood leather edges, dark carved oak trim, muted antique brass, tiny heraldic shield category icons, subtle gothic lancet arches. Warm amber light without luminous text. Mostly pale writing surfaces with near-black ink; the character alcove is darker for contrast. Very fine late-medieval botanical manuscript corner decorations, not excessive baroque scrollwork.
Composition: top dark oxblood navigation strip, below it three integrated vertical sections. Left 32%: full-body 3D traveller inside a narrow wooden gothic alcove, six worn parchment equipment sockets arranged to either side, small health and stamina gauges below. Middle 43%: generous parchment inventory, a practical 5-column by 4-row item grid with about eleven occupied slots, small brass category emblems above and capacity below. Right 25%: a parchment selected-item sheet with a clean large steel sword illustration, readable item name, three well-aligned stat rows and a thin durability line. Selected sword slot has a flat faded-gold inset and a fine warm border. Organic materials have believable wear but no stains across text. The resulting mood is a noble's equipment ledger, grounded, tactile, welcoming and clearly organized.

DIRECTION B — AUSTERE DARK EQUIPMENT MENU, inspired by the quiet, mournful equipment interfaces of Dark Souls.
Smoked charcoal cloth panels, blackened iron seams, desaturated bronze hairline borders, ash-white serif text, a small oxidized ochre selection glow that is subdued rather than magical. Through the dark translucent menu edges, a barely visible ruined stone cloister and fog, visually quiet and softly blurred. Deliberately sparse ornament: rough feathered panel edges, a tiny etched sword mark and subtle scratched metal. NO skull motifs everywhere, no flames or decorative clutter.
Composition: asymmetrical integrated dark pane system. Left 40%: primary equipment and bag area, heading "Снаряжение", two compact rows of worn square worn-metal equipment sockets, then "Сумка" and an orderly inventory grid of 5 columns by 3 rows. Centre 26%: selected-item detail, large vertical steel sword on a near-black field, "Стальной меч", a fine horizontal rule, three short aligned stats and durability bar, ample negative space. Right 34%: full-body live-looking 3D traveller in brown wool and chainmail, softly illuminated in cool side light against the cloister, compact health/stamina and load stats at the bottom; do not overwhelm this section with a full stats spreadsheet. The top navigation runs quietly across the screen. Bottom controls on a thin borderless dark strip. Selected item uses a dark burnished-gold square. Readable ash-white text, understated elegant and severe, not completely black. The interface should look like a playable grounded dark fantasy game, not a website.

DIRECTION C — TRAVELLER'S FIELD LEDGER, an original practical hybrid of warm manuscript materials and dark atmospheric restraint.
An open weathered medieval ledger supplies the menu's visual structure. The book occupies almost the entire screen, perfectly front-on and flat for practical UI readability; a subtle central stitched gutter, thin worn black-brown leather binding, dog-eared warm-grey vellum with occasional muted ink flourishes. Outside the book a very narrow quiet charcoal canvas. Realistic clean raster material details, desaturated parchment rather than bright golden yellow, sage green and aged copper accents, dark brown ink with generous contrast. Hand-etched category icons and leather tab dividers. The feeling is an adventurer's well-used belongings, not a royal illuminated manuscript.
Composition: two large pages, no separate modern dashboard cards. Left page 43%: heading "Снаряжение"; full-body 3D traveller in a lightly shaded illustration-like preview well, six neat equipment sockets around the figure drawn as simple ink squares with small worn brass corners, health/stamina quietly at the foot. Right page 57%: heading "Сумка"; an orderly inventory ledger LIST with substantial colored item thumbnails, item names, weight and quantity in clean ruled columns. 7 visible spacious rows, selected first row "Стальной меч" marked by a translucent sage ink wash and a tiny red cloth bookmark. Below the list a horizontal selected-item detail area occupies the bottom third of the right page, with a long elegant sword preview and the short stats. Top navigation appears on five restrained leather index tabs; selected "Инвентарь" is warm vellum. No physical desk props, no quills or candles occluding UI, no tilted perspective. The structure should be unusually characterful yet easy to translate into modular textures and real engine UI elements.
